name: d31-coach-core
description: D31.UNIVERSE Coach Core tools for a future on-device Gemma-4 / LiteRT-LM build. The web app and the current TWA do not run these models.

tools.name: log_set
tools.description: Save one set into the open Workout Player after the user confirms. Use when they said something like “Squat 120 kg 5 reps”.

exercise_name.description: Spoken or typed name, if the id is not known yet

secs.description: Hold time in seconds, for timed moves

confirmed.description: Must be true before the set is written

tools.name: adjust_program
tools.description: Propose a change to the next session in the user’s current program. Do not silently overwrite their plan; show the change and wait for confirmation.

tools.name: find_moment
tools.description: Jump a locally analysed lift video to a timestamp (deepest squat, form break, lockout, deepest push-up, or a given rep). The video must already have been read on-device; this tool does not upload it.

query.description: The user’s original phrase, in en/hi/gu or Hinglish
